GAMES HUB REDESIGN
Thesis: show the game, not an abstraction. Every card previews the real game state with real idols. The daily blind test is the one dark element, so it wins the eye. One hook line in fan voice, one honest stat, one action per card. Tier Lists added as New. Coming-soon demoted and dimmed. Same tokens as the site: DM Sans, cream, rose, radius 20, rose-tinted shadows.

SAMPLE VALUES
Fans-today, votes, Elo, streak and best-score are illustrative. Mode counts (53 / 4 / 14 / 20) are the real ones from the current page.
